responses.content: First answer. The display is a 320x170 ST7789 panel driven by panel-mipi-dbi-spi, and fbterm renders a 53 column by 12 row grid on top of it. Memory is 512 MB, so the TUI keeps its transcript bounded and serialises messages instead of deep-cloning the whole JSON tree on every request. Tool calls appear before execution: the harness emits tool/call first, runs the body, then emits tool/result, and the transcript shows both lines with a duration. Compaction is token based and follows the DeepSeek Harness algorithm.
